scheme_name: Vidyakiranam Scheme-Educational Assistance To Children Of Disabled Parents
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala
Parent (father or mother) must have a disability of 40% or above
Parent must belong to the BPL category
Student must be enrolled in a government‑approved institution
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹300 to ₹1000 per month for 10 months, amount varying with class level (Standards 1‑5, 6‑10, +1/+2/ITI, and degree/post‑graduation courses).
